phase: Sequential experiment informed by the previous 80 evaluated patients; remaining 20 official validation CT patients reserved for fresh confirmation

primary.population: 20 previously unused official validation CT patients
primary.metric: native-space patient macro Dice, fixed reference-present organs
primary.question: Does acquisition degradation augmentation change the benefit attributable to real adjacent slices, relative to identical repeated-centre inputs?
primary.interval: two-sided 95% paired patient bootstrap, 10000 replicates after averaging matched seeds within patient

secondary: Context gain with and without augmentation at native and factor-3 input
Augmentation gains and native-condition costs within each architecture
Factor-4 severity extrapolation, unseen during training but in the same degradation family
Three-dimensional versus planar architectures with matched augmentation (architecture and capacity remain confounded)
20k versus 40k budget sensitivity for four planar arms; cosine schedule duration also changes, so this does not isolate update count
Development learning trajectories and fraction of runs selecting the final checkpoint
checkpoint_selection: maximum native development patient macro Dice; deterministic earliest tie; no test-based selection
input_and_metric_implementations: Reuse original experiment.py, models.py, prepare_data.py, evaluate.py and native_resample.py without modification
